title: Libra, you are allowed to tip the scale
caption: for the libras who said whatever you want

scenes.text: libra, you don't have to weigh this one.
venus gave you an eye for where beauty belongs.
the right word, the right light, the softest chair.
you carry the scales. you weigh every side first.
you see their point so clearly, you forget you had one.
you keep the peace so well, no one sees what it costs.
but balance was never meant to mean you weigh nothing.
a scale with you missing isn't fair. it's just quiet.
say the honest thing, even if the room goes uneven.
anyone worth keeping can hold a little disagreement.
venus runs your heart. let her want something out loud.
some days, you get to be what tips the scale.
goodnight, libra. order the dessert you actually want.
